decision_order: water-corridor conflict if eligible and robust across thresholds
missing independent outlet for outlet arm
vegetation threshold sensitivity or width ambiguity
outlet-consistent direction with water support and no conflicts

evaluation.eligible_direction_accuracy: only independent verified labels with adequate scale and registration; otherwise null, never zero or100%
evaluation.flag_validation: error=independent direction mismatch only on eligible reaches; count correct/false flags and abstention; otherwise null
evaluation.location: model-stream↔mapped-drain distances and clear spectral corridor association, not physical accuracy
evaluation.raw_direction_diagnostic: cosine sign of local D8 vectors against independent supplied from→to annotation, tangent matched to geometry; threshold cos>0, unavailable zero/outlet vectors; not physical truth
evaluation.uncertainty: No pixel-bootstrap inference; report case/reach dependence; no CI with insufficient independently labelled basins

features.morphology: skeleton/apparent wetted diameter, Theil-Sen median pairwise width slope along terrain orientation; not bathymetry/incision/flow proof
features.vegetation: NDVI distribution, corridor-minus-flank contrast, below-threshold occupancy/continuity; no directional vote
features.water_support: fraction of clear samples within30m of water; connected-component persistence and near-stream skeleton width; threshold range reported

independence.delhi_reference: Previously consumed GSDL mapped geometry. From/To coordinates + INLETNODE/OUTLETNODE are administrative annotations, not verified observed flow; evaluate raw annotation association separately from scale/registration-qualified accuracy.
independence.direction_truth: UNAVAILABLE unless independently verified reach labels supplied

role: DEVELOPMENT ONLY; prespecified exploratory pilot, not independent physical-direction validation

units.engineered: Positive-length clipped mapped drain features; use geometry as evaluation unit only, not predictor; raw from/to/node attributes evaluated only after predictions sealed
units.natural: Nonoverlapping D8 stream reaches between junctions/endpoints on primary network; split at300m, retain >=90m; freeze before reference comparison. Other DEM settings sampled on same primary geometries.

urban_optical.selection: First metadata-ranked full-ROI scene: ascending eo:cloud_cover, datetime, id; maximum100 metadata items per period; no pixel/reference/metric selection
